description: Crafting (packages/core/docs/native-production.md §3.1): what this world knows how to make, out of what, where and with what. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/production/production-predicates.ts’ CRAFTING_PREDICATES_PROLOG verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run production-corpus`. The pack is a COMPOSITION pack over the item and skill vocabularies: it reads has_item/3, item_type/2, has_skill/3 and at_location_type/2 and defines clauses for none of them, and it mints NO RUNTIME PREDICATE at all — what crafting does is move items, and has_item/3 already said that. Its teeth are negative: bare hands at the right forge, the right hammer at the wrong station, and a smith one level short each refuse, because can_craft/2 is a permission and an engine that said yes to all of them would let anybody make anything. With no recipe stated, craft_choice/2 is the one a crafting action makes (PL.core-craft-chooser, U110(4) Q2): the first recipe, in the standard order of atoms, that can_craft/2 allows, and no solution when none does — never a fallback to a recipe the gate refuses. It is the arithmetic half: a recipe the world forbids (forbids/4) is passed over by the director, which asks the legality gate of each candidate in this order (docs/native-production.md §3.6). Every number is whole and there is no percentage anywhere in the pack — a weight is a relative integer, never a probability — and, unlike the v1 mechanic this replaces, there is NO ROLL IN THE PACK AT ALL: v1 drew Math.random() against a hardcoded content table in four separate engine classes, which no native engine can reproduce. What a seeded draw turns up is core’s and is pinned by conformance/production/draws.json instead, because a hash is not expressible as a rule (packages/core/docs/native-production.md §6, divergence P-1). What is NOT here is an item: every output atom is one conformance/prolog/mechanic-equipment.json already owns, and a second item taxonomy here would be the parallel one these four modules exist not to be. Neither is the gate on the work itself — whether a person MAY dig this seam is one more clause of forbids/4, permissible/3 belongs to conformance/prolog/agent-ai.json, and that a refused job writes nothing at all is proved end to end in packages/core/src/game-engine/logic/__tests__/ProductionDirector.test.ts.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-knows-no-recipe-and-does-not-raise
kb: has_inputs(A, R) :- nonvar(A), recipe(R), \+ (recipe_input(R, ItemId, Qty), \+ (has_item(A, ItemId, Held), Held >= Qty)).
missing_input(A, R, ItemId) :- nonvar(A), recipe_input(R, ItemId, Qty), \+ (has_item(A, ItemId, Held), Held >= Qty).

can_craft(A, R) :- nonvar(A), recipe(R), \+ (recipe_station(R, Type), \+ at_location_type(A, Type)), \+ (recipe_tool(R, Tool), \+ (has_item(A, I, Q), Q > 0, item_type(I, Tool))), \+ (recipe_skill(R, S, Min), \+ (has_skill(A, S, L), L >= Min)), has_inputs(A, R).
craft_choice(A, R) :- nonvar(A), can_craft(A, R), \+ (can_craft(A, Other), Other @< R).
